theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_bl_constant_vector_limit
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Xs : ℕ → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (νs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (μs : ℕ → Measure (Euclid P)) (τs : ℕ → Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P n) (s : ℝ), (∀ (k : ℕ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), IsCompact K → νs k K < ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν K < ∞) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x ∂(νs k)) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x ∂ν))) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun k => νs k K) atTop ≤ ν K) → (∀ k, AEStronglyMeasurable (τs k) (νs k)) → 0 ≤ s → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ζ₀ α| ≤ s * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → Tendsto (fun k => ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τs k x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂(νs k)) atTop (𝓝 0)) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), Xs k ω = ∫ x, τs k x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂(νs k)) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, C ω = ∫ x, ζ₀ ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂ν) → (∀ (k : ℕ) (W : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen W → (Xs k).massOn W = μs k W) → WeaklyConvergesOn Xs C ∧ ∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → limsup (fun k => μs k K) atTop ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * ν K
